candidate.description: Join path from PROC-202 (Find LinkedIn) process documentation to the governance spine (imo-creator). Evaluates whether the process is addressable, routable, and auditable from the sovereign governance structure.

hops.from: PROC-202 PROCESS.md §1 Identity → process_id = PROC-202, CTB Position = factory/outreach/202-linkedin-discovery

test_results.round_trip: imo-creator → STRUCTURE_MANIFEST → FLEET_REGISTRY → Barton-Processes → factory/outreach/202-linkedin-discovery → heir.yaml → hub_id=outreach → imo-creator. Circle closes.

heir_field_deviation.measurement: Count of 8 required HEIR schema fields that are missing, empty, or use non-standard names. Fields checked: sovereign_ref, hub_id, ctb_placement, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria. Range: 0-8.
heir_field_deviation.detail: Only hub_id matches the required 8-field schema. Missing: sovereign_ref, ctb_placement, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria. Non-standard fields present (sub_hub, component, process_id, business_silo, parent, created_at) do not satisfy the schema.

join_hop_count.measurement: Number of intermediate lookups required to resolve the join from PROC-202 to the governance spine. Direct = 0 (spine ID present in document). Each intermediate lookup adds fragility. Range: 0-N.
join_hop_count.detail: 4 hops: PROCESS.md → heir.yaml → FLEET_REGISTRY.yaml → STRUCTURE_MANIFEST.yaml → imo-creator. A direct join would have sovereign_ref=imo-creator declared in the HEIR with all 8 fields, reducing to 1 hop.

dmj_join_table_gap.measurement: Binary: does the process document itself contain the DMJ Join table (L21 — 3 columns: Join Path, Type, Description) that documents its own data join to the domain spine (outreach_id)? 0 = present, 1 = missing. This is distinct from the governance join path above — this measures whether the process documents how its DATA reaches the domain spine.
dmj_join_table_gap.detail: No DMJ Join table exists in PROCESS.md. The OSAM Join Chain section (§5) declares the path (slot_workbench.outreach_id) but not in the L21 3-column schema. The content exists but the structure does not.

spine_ambiguity_count.measurement: Count of ambiguous or conflicting spine references found across the process documentation. Multiple conflicting sovereign_refs, missing CTB declarations, or fleet registry mismatches. Range: 0-N.
spine_ambiguity_count.detail: No ambiguity. CTB position in PROCESS.md §1 matches heir.yaml ctb_position matches the physical directory path. hub_id=outreach is consistent with factory/outreach/ placement. Fleet registry lists Barton-Processes as the containing repo. All references converge.

round_trip_break_count.measurement: Count of breaks when tracing the Circle: spine → process → spine. Each break is a hop where the reverse lookup fails or returns a different target. Range: 0-N.
round_trip_break_count.detail: Forward: imo-creator → STRUCTURE_MANIFEST → FLEET_REGISTRY → Barton-Processes → factory/outreach/202-linkedin-discovery. Reverse: 202-linkedin-discovery → heir.yaml hub_id=outreach → FLEET_REGISTRY Barton-Processes → STRUCTURE_MANIFEST factory/ → imo-creator. Circle closes with zero breaks.
